gaps: The dataset is explicitly 'without considering auxiliary heating', so no back-up boiler or electric heater appears.
The collector, storage tank, pump, piping and their disposal are all inside the linked 'solar system ...' infrastructure dataset (Tab. 2.9), not repeated here.
No water or antifreeze make-up for the collector loop.

The BAFU name says 'multiple dwelling' while the report labels this column only 'on flat roof'; the 81 m2 column is the one the report calls 'multiple dwelling', so the column choice rests on the 30 m2 / flat roof match.
